overall: The AG found the Montague By-Law Review Committee, a staff-only group created by Board vote, was a public body subject to the OML and violated it by not posting notice or holding open meetings, though not intentionally; ordered future compliance.

allegations.summary: Complaint said the Board-created By-Law Review Committee, made up of town staff, failed to comply with the OML; the Board said it was not a public body subject to the law.
allegations.key_passage: The plain language of the Open Meeting Law constrains us to find that the Committee was a public body subject to the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Committee held unposted, non-public meetings on by-law review, without posting notice or opening meetings to the public.
allegations.key_passage: Because the Committee did not follow the requirements of the Open Meeting Law, such as posting notice and holding open meetings, the Committee violated the law.

remedy: We therefore order immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, and issue this letter as future guidance.
remedy_passage: We therefore order immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, and issue this letter as future guidance.
